verdict: Red 8/10 REJECT, blue 8/10 SUSTAINED - the cleanest arithmetic kill in the batch, and the one where the thesis's own load-bearing artifact reverses sign on primary data. The triage scored WING 8/10 court-worthy on a single reconstructible claim: that the naive read of the FY26 guide ('H1 at -8.1% must become -4% to 0% in H2') ignores the compare base, and that on a flat two-year stack the year lands about -5.1%, comfortably inside the -4% to -6% guide, with the stack already improving 1.2pp from Q1 to Q2. The triage flagged its own weakness honestly - H1-2025 of about -0.9% was DERIVED by solving from FY25's -3.3% with Q3 and Q4 known, using an unweighted average, and the triage explicitly told the court to pull the actual per-quarter comps before relying on it. Red did exactly that. Q1-25 domestic same-store sales were +0.5% and Q2-25 were -1.9%, both from the company's own releases. The actual split flips the momentum leg: two-year stacks are -8.2 for Q1-26 and -9.4 for Q2-26, so the stack DETERIORATED 1.2pp rather than improving 1.2pp - the exact opposite sign, on the single number the bull case rested on. Blue re-fetched both releases independently, confirmed the figures, and cross-footed them against FY25 (the four quarters average to -3.2% against a reported -3.3%, so the split is internally consistent and not an extraction artifact). Recomputing the bridge on the confirmed base: a dead-flat exit stack of -9.4 gives Q3-26 at -3.8 and Q4-26 at -3.6, landing FY at -5.9%. That is technically inside the guide, so blue was right to note that 'the guide is achievable without a demand recovery' survives in the narrowest possible sense - but it survives pinned to the -6% floor with zero further slippage permitted, after two guide cuts in six months (February's flat-to-low-single-digit-growth, April's low-single-digit decline, July's -4% to -6%). Trend continuation at -1.2pp per quarter gives -6.8% and a third cut. The market pricing a third cut is not a mispricing; it is the trend. Two red findings graded CONFIRMED-SIZING rather than fatal, correctly. The 16x EV/EBITDA is a LEVERED 16x - net debt of about $1.08B against annualized adjusted EBITDA is roughly 4.1x, in a whole-business securitization, which red pulled only after applying the cap-structure discipline the brief skipped. And blue properly REDUCED red's 'earnings growth is buyback engineering' finding: the triage quoted DOLLAR net income up 16.9% to $31.3M, which a 7.5% share-count reduction cannot inflate - dollar NI grew THROUGH the buyback's interest expense. The leverage point stands via the EV finding; the engineering framing overreached. Blue's own new findings cut both ways and are worth carrying: the company-owned same-store stack is base-effect-CLEAN (co-owned bases were HARDER at +1.4% and +3.6%, yet declines were milder, giving stacks of -0.8 and +1.1 against franchised -8.2 and -9.4), so the 9-10pp urban-versus-higher-income gap management describes is real and not a compare-base artifact - though it rests on 51 stores of undisclosed geography. Against that, AUV of -10.4% is partly mechanical mix as 16-19% unit growth pushes sub-ramp units into the base, which means mature-store erosion is less than headline but a NEW franchisee still underwrites at $1.893M - bear-relevant for pipeline conversion. And blue's sharpest structural point: a third guide cut is a sentiment event, not an earnings event - FY -7% versus -5% moves royalty revenue only 1-2%, so November risk is to the multiple, not to EPS. That limits downside surprise and simultaneously confirms there is no bull catalyst. Under the response taxonomy this is a business-risk and timing kill, not a valuation gate. The tape is 0.8% off a 52-week low in a live downtrend with roughly 60 trading days of catalyst vacuum, franchisee capitulation has not begun (one domestic closure and three international in Q2), and the record pipeline is a LAGGING indicator of agreements signed in the 2024-25 boom. WING is covered by roughly 30 analysts, so no orphan or RP_FAIR override applies. What survives is a watch file with three precise triggers, not an entry.
reopen_gates: Q3-26 two-year stack FLAT OR BETTER against the -9.4 exit stack. This is the single decisive trigger - the whole kill is that the stack deteriorates 1.2pp per quarter. Co-owned monthly color counts as early evidence.

Closure-count inflection: domestic closures moving materially above the Q2-26 run-rate of one. The AUV damage is AHEAD of the supply response, not behind it, so the first real capitulation quarter is the signal that the algorithm is resetting rather than compounding.
Price embedding FY -7% with unit growth cut to roughly 10% - i.e. a valuation that no longer requires the guide to hold at its floor. This is the price gate; valuation objections gate PRICE only.
